question: What types of business checking accounts does Dupaco offer?
expected_answer: Three: Business Free Checking (start-ups/small businesses, no minimum balance, no monthly fees), Business 1st Rate Checking (earns a rate; skip the $10 monthly fee by keeping the monthly balance above $5,000) and Business Analysis Checking (established, high-transaction businesses; fees can be offset by deposit balances).
note: snap05 pages/business-checking-accounts-d230fa.md (FAQ lists all three) and business-business-checking-accounts-4b8966.md (duplicate URL /business/business-checking-accounts/, only in snap05, same three accounts).

expected_answer: Business Free Checking, Business 1st Rate Checking and Business Analysis Checking.
note: Paraphrase of the business checking list. Source snap05 pages/business-checking-accounts-d230fa.md.

question: My business keeps about $50,000 in a Business 1st Rate Checking account. What APY would that balance earn?
expected_answer: 0.10% APY (0.10% dividend rate) for the $25,000-$99,999.99 tier. The 2.50% APY tier only applies to balances of $5,000-$24,999.99 (rates effective 06/02/2026).

expected_answer: 2.50% APY (2.47% dividend rate) on balances of $5,000-$24,999.99, rates effective 06/02/2026. Balances of $25,000+ earn 0.10%.

question: Is there a monthly fee for Sweeps on a Dupaco business account?
expected_answer: Yes. Sweeps has a $10 monthly service fee.
note: snap05 business-savings-accounts-735d7b.md FAQ ('Sweeps has a $10 monthly service fee') and business-checking-accounts-d230fa.md ('There is a $10.00 monthly fee for this service'); fee schedule PDF also lists Sweep Fee $10.00 per month.

question: How does the Sweeps service work with business checking, and what does it cost?
expected_answer: You set a target balance for business checking; each day excess funds are automatically moved to savings to earn more, and money is swept back if checking runs low to help prevent overdrafts. You can also link a line of credit to pay it down faster. The service costs $10 per month.
note: Paraphrase of Sweeps fee item. Sources snap05 business-checking-accounts-d230fa.md 'MEET SWEEPS' and business-savings-accounts-735d7b.md.

question: What merchant services does Dupaco offer for businesses that want to accept card payments?
expected_answer: Point of sale systems (inventory tracking, labor management, analytics), mobile solutions (EMV/contactless on a tablet with digital receipts), online integration with third-party shopping carts, countertop terminals (credit, debit, Apple Pay) and virtual terminals that turn a computer into a card terminal.
note: snap05 business-cash-management-8a28c6.md 'Merchant Services' lists exactly five options.

question: What does Business Analysis Checking cost per month at Dupaco?
expected_answer: Per Dupaco's Rate and Fee Schedule (effective Feb. 17, 2025): $10.00 monthly fee, $0.15 per item for checks paid and items deposited, and $0.10 per ACH item. The monthly fees can be offset or minimized by maintaining certain deposit balances, and Dupaco will help estimate the cost before you open.
note: Business checking pages (snap05 business-checking-accounts-d230fa.md) only say fees can be offset by balances and link the fee schedule; amounts come from pages/hubfs-dupaco-credit-union-fee-schedule-miscellaneous-fees-jan-15-2025-1-pdf-312b5a.md. Do not confuse with the $10 1st Rate Checking fee or $10 Sweep fee.

question: What's the most I can borrow with a Dupaco small business loan?
expected_answer: The small business loan is for financing needs under $50,000 (FAQ: eligible borrowers may borrow up to $50,000), with fixed monthly payments.
note: snap05 business-loans-small-business-loans-353850.md ('less than $50,000'; intro has typo '$50,0000'; FAQ 'up to $50,000') and business-loans-ee7b0b.md ('For loans under $50,000').

question: I need a small loan for my side business. How much can I get from Dupaco and what should I include with the application?
expected_answer: Small business loans are for amounts under $50,000. Complete the small business loan application and personal financial statement, include personal and business tax returns from the past two years (plus a purchase agreement if buying), then submit online or at a branch. Guarantees are required and you must be a Dupaco member.
note: Paraphrase of small business loan item. snap05 business-loans-small-business-loans-353850.md 'Let's Make It Simple' steps and FAQ.

question: If I move my auto loan from another lender to Dupaco, how much cash back do I get?
expected_answer: Through Switch and Earn you get 1% of the refinanced amount, up to $300 per eligible loan (minimum loan $5,000), paid within 3-5 business days after the loan is funded. Your first payment can also be delayed up to 45 days. You must mention the offer, and existing Dupaco loans don't qualify.
note: snap05 switch-and-earn-784cd2.md (unchanged across all five snapshots).

question: What's the biggest bonus I can get from Dupaco's Switch and Earn refinance promo, and is there a minimum loan size?
expected_answer: Up to $300 cash back (1% of the external payoff amount) per auto, motorcycle, personal or recreational loan refinanced, and the minimum loan amount is $5,000.
note: Paraphrase of Switch and Earn item; fine print in snap05 switch-and-earn-784cd2.md.

question: If I open an Achieve Money Market account now, what rate will I earn?
expected_answer: An introductory 4.00% dividend rate (3.66% APY) for the first 6 months (180 days) when you open with at least $25,000 in new money or Dupaco certificate funds that matured within 10 days. After that it converts to the standard variable rate, currently 3.20% dividend / 3.25% APY. Business accounts are excluded, and there's a limit of one per member.
note: snap05 earn-more-3ae90d.md and personal-savings-account-7ef72e.md show the 4.00% intro (as of 8/24/26). Conflict: membermoneymarket-lp-ff5ced.md (still live in snap05) headlines 'Boost your APY to 3.25%' (rates 10/01/2025) with no intro offer. 3.25% is still correct as the post-promo APY.

question: I closed my Dupaco checking account about a year ago. If I open a new one, can I still get the $300 new-checking bonus?
expected_answer: No. Under the current terms you're ineligible if you open a Dupaco Share Draft Checking account within 730 days of closing one you owned. Current owners of a Dupaco checking account are also ineligible.
note: snap05 checking-offer-lp-a3545a.md and tax-checking-offer-lp-224250.md fine print: 730 days. Snapshots 01-02 (checking-offer-lp, makethemost-lp) said 'within 180 days after closing', which would wrongly make a one-year-ago closer eligible.

question: Can I turn off two-step verification on my Shine online banking?
expected_answer: No. Two-step verification is required for all Shine Online Banking accounts and can't be removed. You can get codes by text instead of email by adding your mobile number, or skip code entry by turning on face/fingerprint recognition or PIN login in Shine Mobile, or choosing 'Trust this device' in Shine Online.
note: snap05 manage-account-alerts-ee21ea.md (unchanged across snapshots).

question: I'm tired of getting my Dupaco 2-step codes by email. What are my options?
expected_answer: Add your mobile number so codes come by text. In Shine Mobile go to Profile > Two Step Notification > Add contact; in Shine Online go to Profile > Edit Profile > Actions > edit two-step. To skip codes entirely, enable face/fingerprint or PIN login in Shine Mobile, or 'Trust this device' in Shine Online (not recommended on devices you don't own).
note: Paraphrase of two-step item; snap05 manage-account-alerts-ee21ea.md.

expected_answer: Securities and advisory services are offered through LPL Financial (member FINRA/SIPC); Dupaco itself is not a broker-dealer or investment adviser. The LPL registered representatives may only do securities business with residents of Iowa, Wisconsin and Illinois.

question: Does Dupaco have a savings account for young kids, and what does it take to open one?
expected_answer: Yes. The DoPACK kids account is for kids age 12 and under. It opens with $25 and earns the same rates as regular savings. Each deposit of $5 or more earns a paw print on a Saver's Club Card toward prizes, and DoPACK kids get mail with money tips and activities. Call 800-373-7600 or visit a branch to open one.

question: What can I do at a Dupaco live video teller, and do I need my debit card to use one?
expected_answer: You can deposit cash or checks, withdraw cash, make loan payments, transfer money between accounts and order checks, just like with an in-person teller. No debit card is needed: tap the screen and the teller verifies your identity. Some are in drive-up lanes and some in branch lobbies.

question: Someone called saying they're from Dupaco's fraud department and asked me to confirm my debit card PIN. Is that legit?
expected_answer: No. Dupaco will never ask for your PIN, Shine password, two-step verification code or full card number. Fraudsters can spoof Dupaco's caller ID. Hang up and call Dupaco directly at 800-373-7600. If you give out your PIN, resulting transactions are treated as verified.
note: snap05 learn-blog-did-you-get-a-call-about-card-fraud-5c16ce.md (2021 vishing article) and learn-blog-is-this-really-dupaco-*.md ('Dupaco will never ask for' list).
